raw_text: Never commit `.env` files or secrets. Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`. Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made. See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures. Star-topology: Triage routes to 5 specialists, who hand back. Add tools in `maf/tools/`, agents in `maf/agents/`; wire PM Copilot agents in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`. Mock/live Graph via `GRAPH_MODE`. Setup: `python -m venv .venv`; `source .venv/bin/activate`; `pip install -r requirements.txt`; `cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum`. Start: `python app.py --console|--server|--devui|--copilotkit`. Server: `cd maf_copilotkit/agent`; `uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate`; `uv pip install -e .`; `uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000`. Web: `cd maf_copilotkit/web`; `pnpm install && pnpm dev`. AG-UI: `cd tmp-ag-ui`; `pnpm install && pnpm build`; `pnpm test`; `pnpm lint`; `pnpm dev`.
